title: Prediction
description: Predict which values belong in an effect dependency array.
prompt: What should be included in this effect dependency array?

options.label: Keep [] because document.title only needs to be set once.
Include lessonTitle and completedLessons because the effect reads them.
Include every prop in the component, even if the effect does not read it.

responses.empty-array: Not quite. The effect reads changing render values, so an empty array can leave the title stale.
responses.used-values: Correct. Dependencies should match the rendered values the effect reads.
responses.all-props: Not quite. Dependencies should describe what this effect uses, not every value nearby.

metadata.reason: Catches the misconception that dependency arrays are manual run schedules.
